prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. IMAGE 1: existing game obstacle sprite, EDIT TARGET. IMAGE 2: the actual repeating map ground, COLOR AND GROUND MATERIAL REFERENCE ONLY. This sprite will be placed at arbitrary positions on image 2. Change only the soil, grout and outer ground transition in IMAGE 1 so it blends naturally with IMAGE 2. Match the actual reference's desaturated grey-brown/taupe soil, dusty brown-grey stone and muted olive moss; remove the obstacle soil's yellow-orange/beige colour cast. MATCH the reference's brightness and saturation, not just general hue. Retain all puddles, paving slab shapes and markings. Tone the soil and slab dirt toward the map reference; subdue overly yellow ground markings. Keep blue-grey water distinct. Render a mottled irregular feathered alpha transition, mixing map-matched dusty earth, scattered same-tone fragments and partially transparent brush marks; no continuous halo or outlining. The transition may extend a little into available transparent padding, but no clipping. IMPORTANT preserve exact original canvas dimensions/aspect ratio, core shape, location and PIXEL SCALE of all objects. Existing gameplay collider is frozen; no resizing, rearranging, shifting or new collision-worthy objects. Match reference tones at the outer edge particularly carefully. Keep stylized matte storybook illustration. Output only ONE standalone RGBA sprite on TRUE TRANSPARENT background, including semi-transparent transition pixels. Never bake the rectangular reference ground tile or a surrounding opaque floor into the output. No frame, words, dark border, white vignette, glow halo or colour fringe.
constraints: preserve canvas, pivot, world scale and interior object positions
visual transition only; existing dense-core collider remains unchanged
